segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Geographic segment selling water technologies and solutions for commercial and residential buildings in the Americas.
segments.evidence: Our strategy is to be the preferred supplier of differentiated products and solutions that manage and conserve the flow of fluids and energy into, through and out of buildings in the commercial and residential markets of the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa ("APMEA"), our three geographic segments.
